purpose: Copy for the left-panel About tab. The viewer renders #aboutInfoPanel from this file (renderAbout in viewer_core.js) so the wording lives here as reviewable data instead of as inline HTML. Edit the text here, not in index.html. Structure: heading, intro (one welcome paragraph with an optional inline link), sections[] (each an optional subhead + paragraphs), rules (lead + bullet list), note. Source copy: brain/import/TBI.copy.
heading: About the Rock Warblers

intro.lead: Welcome to our first event as the Rock Warblers, the
intro.tail: at Adventure Off Road Park, Friday, June 19 through Sunday, June 21. Come hang out for a weekend of scaled adventure. All you have to bring is a good attitude.

paragraphs: We're the ones in the bright blue shirts. Kin to the Diamond-Billed Rock Pecker, found only in Moab, Utah, and known for our ultimate scale builds. caw-craaawl! You'll spot us mostly east of the Mississippi, with sightings up in Canada, Pennsylvania, West Virginia, Michigan, and North Carolina, and a rare breed migrating between Europe and North America.

sections.heading: The park & the map
paragraphs: Adventure Off Road Park, South Pittsburg, TN: six hundred acres of private ridge, with the pavilion as base camp for registration, the driver's meeting, dinner, awards, and the fire pit. Camping on-site, first come, first served.
The map is your on-day reference, built from GPS data and real terrain to show the high-traffic hot spots and areas of interest around the park.

sections.heading: What to expect
paragraphs: We meet at the pavilion before each event. Trails run off to the right by the buggy entrance, and the Jeep entrance is open to explore too. Run a GPS tracking app while you roam and share where you went, and we'll keep updating the map as the hot spots turn up.

Trails are open to full-scale crawlers and bouncers all weekend, so keep your eyes and ears open and yield to the bigger rigs. The C.O.W. is parked nearby through the day with batteries and basic necessities.

We're running a 50/50 raffle. Half goes to one lucky winner, half to Appalachian RC for Kids, a West Virginia program that gets RC rigs to kids under 12 who don't have one of their own. Tickets are 5 for $10.

items: Penalty points for gate touches, rollovers, and hogging.
Trail repairs and cleanup earn karma points that cancel penalties.
And most importantly, have some fun.

note: Made by the Rock Warblers. See you at the pavilion.
